title: Hearty Malaysian Morcilla Satay
description: A fermented and aerated Malaysian dish featuring morcilla, perfect for meal prep. This gluten-free-friendly satay is dehydrated to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the dehydrator to 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the morcilla into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
In a blender, combine coconut milk, lime juice, brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, and cayenne pepper, and blend until smooth.
Pour the marinade into a large bowl and add the sliced morcilla, mixing well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow fermentation.
Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated morcilla pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the dehydrator and dehydrate for 3 hours.
Serve the satay hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.
